summary:
Comprehensive architectural and implementation plan to:
1. Wrap all row column headers in a floating white card container on the grey pod with functional sort/filter arrows on every column across all screens.
2. Fix bulk selection across all screens and deploy a standardized floating bottom pill toolbar featuring category-tailored secondary actions and a delete handler.
3. Remove redundant top view tabs and integrate a 3rd Calendar view icon into the row view switcher on Schedule, Timetable, Booking, and Agenda screens.
